verdict.rationale: Aider has no native scheduler, but it is scriptable: `--message` runs one instruction, applies edits and exits, and the Python `Coder.run()` API executes an instruction and returns. That makes it usable as a step in recurring jobs driven by an external tool like cron or CI, which is how one user describes using it in PR pipelines. missing for 10: native scheduling or recurring-job capability, documented workflow orchestration, any first-party guidance on cron/CI scheduling, hands-on evidence of scheduled use.
